final: WITH per_tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM per_tel), k1 AS (SELECT a FROM per_tel, b1 WHERE a > b1.v AND a IS NOT NULL), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM k1), fin AS (SELECT a FROM k1, b2 WHERE a > b2.v) SELECT AVG(fin.a) AS mean_avg, AVG(fin.a - b1.v) AS mean_excess_b1, AVG(fin.a - b2.v) AS mean_excess_b2 FROM fin, b1, b2
